about: Real Claude Code v2.1.321 screens (classic renderer, 100x30, xterm-256color), recorded through a pty on 2026-11-20 (S58) for the compose box's bar detection (docs/compose-box.md D8). Each recording is a list of chunks as read from the pty ({t: seconds, b: base64 bytes}) with step marks ({t, mark}) placed after the step settled. Recorded with hooks off and transcripts off, so a 'Transcript saving is off' line sits in Claude's footer.

notes.steps: idle; typed 'hello there' into Claude's own bar; Ctrl+C; a long line that wraps; 'first line\\' Enter 'second line' (multi-line); Ctrl+C; a prompt asking Claude to use AskUserQuestion, then the question dialog ('question'), Esc; a prompt to run 'ls docs' (auto mode ran it, so 'permission' is the idle screen after that turn), Esc; Up arrow (history recall of the multi-line entry: its top rule reads '─── History 103/103 ───'); Ctrl+C; '/' (slash menu); Ctrl+C.
notes.queue: a 60-line answer, with 'and then say done' sent while Claude works: the queued message renders above the bar, and the bar shows Claude's dim hint 'Press up to edit queued messages' (glyph grey #999999, caret inverse on 'P', the rest dim).
notes.turn: a short turn (count 1 to 45): after 22 of 26 chunks the cursor rests on the bar; the other 4 end mid-redraw on the footer line.
notes.bypassIdle: startup with --dangerously-skip-permissions: the footer reads '⏵⏵ bypass permissions on'.
